meta.title: Schedule the onboarding event times
gaps: No catalog assertion directly reads the selected onboarding Start time, Duration/End time, or Evaluation time.
No catalog step directly verifies those scheduled times in Onboarding Details on the vendor profile.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: No catalog assertion directly reads the selected onboarding Start time, Duration/End time, or Evaluation time.; No catalog step directly verifies those scheduled times in Onboarding Details on the vendor profile.

args.goal: In the already-open Onboarding Prospects side panel with a template selected, change the Start time, change the Duration so the End time updates, change the Evaluation time, confirm the schedule, then open the vendor profile and verify Onboarding Details shows the chosen scheduled times.

steps.note: Performs the onboarding-specific scheduling flow and checks the vendor-profile result in the current browser session.
Confirms the session ends without a visible error or broken screen after scheduling and verification.
